The speaker notes that Wells Fargo was the largest bank by count of SBA loans per quarter before COVID hit, doing 692 loans in the quarter before the pandemic.

thesis: This episode examines the controversy surrounding pandemic relief loans, specifically questioning whether wealthy companies like Amazon should have received Paycheck Protection Program funding given their growth during the crisis. It also highlights Wells Fargo's significant role in originating SBA loans prior to the pandemic, noting it was the largest bank by loan count in the quarter before COVID.
